raw.details:
Build a real-time mobility solution in 48 hours with Condense.

Configure 2026 is a free, online hackathon by Condense and Bosch Mobility Platforms & Solutions, part of MPS Summit 2026. Pick a real problem in mobility, then build a real-time data pipeline and app to solve it, with Condense as your streaming backbone.

Important:

Your team is only entered once the team leader fills in the registration form by 26 November. Please complete your registration here: https://www.condense.io/configure-2026

We have updated the rulebook. Please visit the website to view it! 

What you could build:

  • Fleet tracking and management

  • Vehicle health and predictive maintenance

  • Geofencing and real-time alerts

  • EV battery and charging intelligence

  • Driver behaviour and safety

  • Logistics and last-mile optimization

  • Or your own mobility idea

How it works (all times IST):

  • Register your team by Thursday 26 November
  • Set up your Condense workspace and run the sample pipeline before kickoff
  • Join the kickoff webinar on Friday 27 November, 9:30 PM (it's recorded)
  • Build from Saturday 28 November, 12:00 AM to Sunday 29 November, 11:59 PM, with help on Discord
  • Submit by Sunday 29 November, 11:59 PM
  • Winners announced by Wednesday 2 December

Who can join:

Students, working professionals and early-stage startups aged 18+, from anywhere in the world. Teams of 1 to 3, solo entries welcome. Entry is free.

What you get:

  • Your own Condense workspace and a shared Kafka cluster, so you don't need your own

  • A starter kit with sample vehicle telemetry, GPS and CAN-like data generators

  • Help from Condense engineers and mobility mentors on Discord

  • A $3,000 cash prize pool, plus invitations to the Bosch MPS Hackathon for top teams

Share what you build with #Configure26
